column4: dialect-gated: cleat#3571 regression test, one function per dialect (same shape as another-tenants-history-is-swept-on-sql-server.tsv) so the SQL Server arm skips on its own without taking the PostgreSQL arm with it. This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) supplies no SQL Server, so exactly this function skips. It FAILS rather than skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set and the server is unreachable (mssqlHBRig pings it), so the skip can only mean "this job has no SQL Server". Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestATenantsBeatDoesNotQueueBehindTheExecutionPool -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly this one.
